limitations: Initial UI had an Editor SearchDatabase.IndexationOnStartup ArgumentOutOfRangeException and an invalid font warning. Keep their original stack traces; three post-fixture-fix UI cycles were clean but do not prove the SearchDatabase cause or resolution.
Fixture fix was an overlay of two Editor test files on the fc66af7 Git consumer. No production Runtime/sample code changed.
Existing native allocation diagnostics, cold-machine performance, new-helper Player UI, macOS/iOS/Android CPU/GPU, release candidate/tag consumers and formal Release remain incomplete.
Cache stage timings are single measurements and exclude model deserialization, Worker setup and embedding inference.
Total allocated memory readings are Editor-wide; GPU memory is unknown.
New consumer did not reimport the original pt2 or repeat M1 embedding all 15 cases; it used token15 and the real search full four-condition suite.
